"import cadquery as cq

# Parameters (all in mm)
PLATE_X = 90
PLATE_Y = 60
PLATE_Z = 10

BOSS_DIAMETER = 30
BOSS_HEIGHT = 20

HOLE_DIAMETER = 8
HOLE_OFFSET_X = 33
HOLE_OFFSET_Y = 18

# Create base plate: centered on origin in XY, base face at z=0
result = cq.Workplane("XY").box(PLATE_X, PLATE_Y, PLATE_Z, centered=(True, True, False))

# Add cylindrical boss on top face (boss top at z = PLATE_Z + BOSS_HEIGHT = 30)
result = (
    result.faces(">Z")
    .workplane()
    .circle(BOSS_DIAMETER / 2)
    .extrude(BOSS_HEIGHT)
)

# Add four through holes (axes parallel to Z, through plate thickness only)
# Bolt holes are far enough from the boss axis that cutThruAll only affects the plate
result = (
    result.faces("<Z")
    .workplane()
    .pushPoints([
        (+HOLE_OFFSET_X, +HOLE_OFFSET_Y),
        (+HOLE_OFFSET_X, -HOLE_OFFSET_Y),
        (-HOLE_OFFSET_X, +HOLE_OFFSET_Y),
        (-HOLE_OFFSET_X, -HOLE_OFFSET_Y),
    ])
    .circle(HOLE_DIAMETER / 2)
    .cutThruAll()
)

# Export final single solid
cq.exporters.export(result.val(), "part.step")"
